persona: English is her second language: short sentences, simple grammar, sometimes wrong tense. Polite and cooperative. Has one photo and the builder quote on her phone.
initial_message: Hello, I want make claim for my house. On Wednesday 16th in the afternoon was very heavy rain and water is coming inside my lounge from the ceiling corner, it run down the wall. The carpet in the corner also wet. Next day I clean the gutter and now no more water come inside. Nobody hurt.

facts.policyholder.name: Aroha Saltmarsh
facts.incident.description: During very heavy rain on Wednesday afternoon the box gutter above the lounge overflowed. Water came in at the corner of the lounge ceiling and ran down the wall. I put towels down. On Thursday I cleared leaves from the gutter outlet and no more water came in.
facts.incident.cause: The box gutter outlet was blocked with leaves and overflowed in very heavy rain
facts.loss.description: Lounge ceiling corner stained and bubbling over about 1 m by 1.5 m; wall lining below swollen at the bottom; carpet in that corner wet
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Put towels down and moved the sofa away from the wall
facts.mitigation.temporary_repair: Cleared leaves from the box gutter outlet on Thursday 17 September 2026
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the ceiling corner and the wall, taken on Wednesday afternoon. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Kauri Dean Builders, total $2,714.00 including GST. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_quote_date: The builder came to look on Friday 18 September and sent the quote the same day. I did not look at the date on it.
facts.if_asked_about_gutter: I clear the gutters every autumn. There were many leaves after the wind the week before.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo of the corner of a living room where a white ceiling meets two pale grey painted walls. A large yellow-brown water stain spreads across the ceiling from the corner, the paint bubbling and peeling, and dark wet streaks run down the wall below it to the white skirting board. The grey carpet in the corner is darker where it is wet, and a folded towel lies on it. Soft afternoon daylight from a window out of frame. The frame shows only the ceiling corner, the wall and the carpet corner.

design.notes: Planted: the builder quote is dated 11 September 2026, five days before the rain on 16 September 2026, while the claimant says the builder came on 18 September.

triage.rationale: The builder quote is dated 11 September 2026, before the rain on 16 September 2026: a strong indicator, so a person must look, and a material that contradicts the statement (the claimant says the builder came on 18 September). Photo and quote are both present; the total is NZD 2,714.00; the gutter is cleared and nothing is still leaking. A blocked gutter is a maintenance question for staff, not a triage reason. Allowed: the claimant cannot explain the quote date (question_unanswered). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: Quote dated 11 September 2026 is before the first possible incident day, 16 September 2026

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 July 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2020-07-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
